# Slider props

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `labels` | `Partial<SliderLabels>` | — | Replaces the built-in English strings, e.g. to translate them. Keys you leave out keep the default from `DEFAULT_SLIDER_LABELS`. `getAriaValueText` and `aria-valuetext` on a thumb take precedence. |

## Labels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rangeStart` | `(value: string) => string` | `(value) => "20 start range"` | The `aria-valuetext` of the first thumb of a range slider (two values). Gets the formatted value. |
| `rangeEnd` | `(value: string) => string` | `(value) => "80 end range"` | The `aria-valuetext` of the second thumb of a range slider. Gets the formatted value. |
